description.value: Shiny Tea is a Taiwanese tea cafe chain with over 30 years of history, bringing high-quality teas sourced directly from Taiwan to the Greater Vancouver area. The cafe offers a range of traditional Taiwanese teas — oolong, green, black, and pu-erh — alongside their signature TeaLato, a fusion of Taiwanese tea and Italian gelato. The Kingsway location is one of several outlets across Greater Vancouver, with mobile app ordering and pickup available.
